_doc: Threshold triple per metric: baseline (what it was when the metric was born),
target (where it should be), alert (where it demands action). A metric with no
entry here prints 'no target' and metrics.py refuses to treat it as a signal —
a dashboard nobody acts on is the 'metrics without targets' antipattern.
Baselines ship as null: measure your own engagements with metrics.py, then record
the numbers here together with measured_at.

override_rate.why: Below ~10% the human gate is rubber-stamping; above ~40% the producers are being fed a bad context. Read it from canonical verdict lines until the gate emits gate_decision events.

agreement_rate.why: Share of consilium signals the manager SUSTAINED. Low agreement means validators are noisy or the acceptor is overruling on taste.

iv_tempo_ratio.why: Production time over validation time. Past ~2 validation is the bottleneck; past 3 stop adding delivery capacity and fix validation first.

rework_rate.why: Share of specialist reports that are reworks. Read it alongside agreement_rate — a low rework rate with falling agreement means reviews are passing work they should not.

evidence_completeness.why: Engagements carrying handoff + acceptance-log + ledger. The ones that miss one cannot be reconstructed later.

ledger_coverage.why: Engagements that produced any ledger. Collect from the engagement root and from multi-track subdirectories (primary/), or multi-track engagements silently count as zero.

verdict_canonical_rate.why: Acceptance-logs carrying the canonical verdict line. Logs without it are unreadable by any acceptance metric.

l_tier_share.why: Share of engagements run at L. L costs a consilium of five reviewers; if almost everything is L, tier routing is not routing.

post_accept_defect_rate.why: Defects found after ACCEPT, per accepted engagement. The only honest quality signal; needs post_accept_defect events to exist.

outcome_validation_rate.why: Share of outcome hypotheses confirmed after deploy. Currently unmeasurable because criteria.md carries no hypothesis to close.

tokens_recorded.why: Aggregate tokens seen in the ledger. Not a quality target — it is the data source that makes the Tier-14 budget guard real.

high_risk_ungated_rate.why: Engagements marked `risk: high` (irreversible: auth, payments, PII, migrations, deletion, publish) that reached acceptance with no human gate decision. Target zero, alert on the first one — this is the axis that catches a small-but-dangerous change taking the S-tier path, which `size:` alone cannot see.

outcome_hypothesis_rate.why: criteria.md files carrying an Outcome hypothesis. Without one an engagement can say what was delivered but not whether it helped.
